message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| Year | Title | Why it’s worth watching |
|------|-------|------------------------|
| 1978 | **The Shining** | Stanley Kubrick’s masterful psychological terror with iconic imagery. |
| 1980 | **The Thing** | John Carpenter’s tense, claustrophobic alien invasion with groundbreaking practical effects. |
| 1984 | **A Nightmare on Elm Street** | Wes Craven’s inventive slasher featuring Freddy Krueger’s dream‑world menace. |
| 1991 | **The Silence of the Lambs** | A chilling blend of crime thriller and psychological horror with Hannibal Lecter. |
| 1999 | **The Blair Witch Project** | Found‑footage style that sparked a new wave of horror realism. |
| 2002 | **28 Days Later** | A post‑apocalyptic zombie film that revives the genre with speed and dread. |
| 2004 | **Saw** | A gritty, puzzle‑based horror that spawned a long-running franchise. |
| 2007 | **Paranormal Activity** | Low‑budget found‑footage that delivers genuine jump‑scares. |
| 2010 | **The Conjuring** | A modern supernatural thriller grounded in real‑life paranormal investigators. |
| 2012 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | A meta‑take on horror tropes that’s both funny and genuinely scary. |
| 2014 | **It Follows** | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” concept with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 2015 | **The Witch** | A slow‑burn, atmospheric period horror that builds dread through atmosphere. |
| 2017 | **Get Out** | Jordan Peele’s socially conscious horror that blends satire with genuine terror. |
| 2018 | **A Quiet Place** | A tense, sound‑driven thriller that keeps you on edge. |
| 2019 | **Midsommar** | A daylight horror that subverts expectations with unsettling folk rituals. |
| 2020 | **The Invisible Man** | A modern retelling of the classic with strong psychological depth. |
| 2021 | **Candyman** | A contemporary reimagining of the urban legend with social commentary. |
| 2022 | **The Black Phone** | A supernatural thriller that mixes creepy atmosphere with a compelling story. |
| 2023 | **M3GAN** | A horror‑comedy about a murderous AI doll that’s both funny and frightening. |

Feel free to pick based on your preferred sub‑genre—psychological, supernatural, slasher, or found‑footage—and enjoy the chills!
